newsitem.title: CANADA: Hyundai to ship Canada plant to India.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai to ship Canada plant to India.

text.p: Hyundai Auto Canada, a unit of Hyundai Motor Co Ltd of South Korea, said on Friday it was shipping some equipment from its mothballed Bromont, Quebec assembly plant to new plants in South Korea, India and other unspecified countries.
"What we are announcing today is quite common in the world automobile industry", Hyundai Auto Canada president Y. I. Lee said in a statement.
"Many manufacturers shift production equipment from one location to another in order to respond quickly to changing conditions in the marketplace".
Hyundai said that since Bromont was closed in September 1993, it had maintained the plant in production-ready condition.
We will continue to spend whatever is necessary to properly maintain the Bromont plant and to maximize the plant's value in the future", Lee said.
"The Bromont plant is still a valuable asset and an important part of Hyundai's overall global production strategy."
